name: Role-Playing Games
description: Questions about fantasy worlds, tabletop systems (D&D), video game RPGs, the history of the genre, and mechanics that defined RPGs.

questions.question: Which 1974 game created by Gary Gygax and Dave Arneson is widely considered the first commercial tabletop role-playing game in history?
questions.explanation_correct: D&D revolutionized gaming by introducing the role of the Dungeon Master (DM) and polyhedral dice.
questions.explanation_incorrect: RuneQuest, Traveller, and Warhammer were developed in the late 70s and 80s, building upon D&D's success.

questions.question: In which fictional town on the Sword Coast does the story of the first Baldur's Gate (1998) begin?
questions.explanation_correct: The player character begins the game as the ward of the sage Gorion in Candlekeep, a fortified library-keep.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Baldur's Gate is the destination city in the game, Athkatla is the capital of Amn from Baldur's Gate II, and Neverwinter is a city from a different series.

questions.question: Which tabletop RPG system created by Mike Pondsmith debuted in the 1980s as a retro-futuristic cyberpunk game?
questions.explanation_correct: Cyberpunk 2020 (originally released in 1988 as Cyberpunk 2013) became an iconic paper-and-pencil system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Shadowrun blends cyberpunk with fantasy, GURPS is a generic system, and World of Darkness centers on gothic horror and vampires.

questions.question: What is the name of the planet where the majority of games in The Elder Scrolls series take place?
questions.explanation_correct: Nirn (meaning 'Arena' in Ehlnofex) is the planet, with Tamriel being the primary continent where games are set.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Tamriel is the continent on Nirn, while Morrowind and Skyrim are provinces within Tamriel.

questions.question: Which development studio created and led the Fallout franchise before the rights were acquired by Bethesda in 2007?
questions.explanation_correct: Black Isle Studios developed the first two legendary Fallout games under publisher Interplay.
questions.explanation_incorrect: BioWare never worked on Fallout, Obsidian developed Fallout: New Vegas in 2010, and Troika was formed by former Fallout creators.

questions.question: What does the abbreviation RPG stand for in the context of computer and tabletop games?
questions.explanation_correct: A Role-Playing Game involves players assuming the roles of characters in a fictional setting and developing their statistics.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Rules, Random, and Run-Play-Gain are incorrect interpretations of this popular acronym.

questions.question: Which polyhedral die is the primary tool for determining success in Dungeons & Dragons?
questions.explanation_correct: The 20-sided die (d20) is rolled for skill checks, attack rolls, and saving throws in D&D mechanics.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The d10, d12, and d6 are used for rolling damage or other specific checks.

questions.question: From which fantasy universe does Geralt of Rivia, the protagonist of CD Projekt Red's RPG trilogy, originate?
options: Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings
questions.explanation_correct: CD Projekt Red's games are a direct sequel to the Witcher saga written by the Polish fantasy author.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are famous fantasy universes unrelated to Geralt of Rivia.

questions.question: Which MMORPG released by Blizzard Entertainment in 2004 became the most popular game of its genre worldwide?
questions.explanation_correct: World of Warcraft dominated the MMO market, reaching over 12 million active subscribers at its peak.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Lineage II, Guild Wars, and EverQuest are other popular MMOs, but none achieved the scale of WoW's success.

questions.question: Which iconic 1999 RPG powered by the Infinity Engine featured an immortal protagonist called 'The Nameless One' seeking his identity?
questions.explanation_correct: Planescape: Torment is considered a masterpiece of writing in video games, thanks to its philosophical plot and unique companions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Baldur's Gate II and Icewind Dale used the same engine but had standard death mechanics. Arcanum was built on a different engine.

questions.question: What is the name of the Polish post-apocalyptic RPG system released by Portal in 2003?
questions.explanation_correct: Neuroshima depicts humanity's struggle against a ruthless artificial intelligence named Moloch in a destroyed USA.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Dzikie Pola is set in historical Poland, Monastyr is dark fantasy cloak-and-dagger, and Klanarchia is Polish horror fantasy.

questions.question: Which entities in the Fallout franchise are officially blamed for starting the Great War by dropping the first bombs?
options: It is left ambiguous - the war was between the US and China
questions.answer: It is left ambiguous - the war was between the US and China
questions.explanation_correct: Fallout's lore deliberately leaves who fired the first missile ambiguous, emphasizing the self-destructive nature of mankind.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Skynet is from Terminator, Moloch is from Neuroshima, and ZETA is an alien ship from Fallout 3 DLC.

questions.question: Which graphical MMORPG released in 1997 is considered the pioneer of virtual economies and player-driven worlds?
questions.explanation_correct: Ultima Online, created under Richard Garriott, revolutionized mass multiplayer interactions on a single server.
questions.explanation_incorrect: EverQuest and Tibia launched in the late 90s, but Ultima Online is widely credited as the first major success.

questions.question: Which studio founded by former Black Isle employees (including Feargus Urquhart) created Fallout: New Vegas and Pillars of Eternity?
questions.explanation_correct: Obsidian is renowned for complex RPGs with deep branching narratives and moral ambiguity.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Troika created Vampire: Bloodlines, BioWare created Dragon Age, and Larian created Baldur's Gate 3.

questions.question: What is the general term for the person who runs the game session and describes the world to players?
questions.explanation_correct: Game Master (GM) is the universal term used across most tabletop RPG systems.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Dungeon Master (DM) is trademarked by D&D, Narrator is used in specific systems, and Storyteller is used in White Wolf games.

questions.question: Which action RPG series developed by FromSoftware popularized a grimdark fantasy aesthetic and highly challenging boss battles?
questions.explanation_correct: The Dark Souls series created the 'soulslike' genre, focusing on patient combat, stamina management, and trial-and-error.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Final Fantasy is a turn-based series, Monster Hunter centers on boss fights without typical RPG exploration, and Dragon's Dogma is an open-world RPG by Capcom.

questions.question: What is the name of the valley and island where the events of the cult RPG Gothic (2001) take place?
questions.explanation_correct: The first Gothic takes place inside the Mining Colony, located on the island of Khorinis, under a magical dome.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Myrtana is the mainland kingdom, and Nordmar and Varant are regions on the mainland featured in Gothic 3.

questions.question: What does 'Real-time with pause' mean in RPG combat systems?
options: The ability to freeze the game at any moment to issue orders to characters
Auto-saving the game state in real time
A limited time window to take your turn during combat
Resting mechanics that recover character stats
questions.answer: The ability to freeze the game at any moment to issue orders to characters
questions.explanation_correct: Real-time with pause combines the speed of real-time action with the tactical planning of turn-based systems.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options describe save systems, turn limits, or resting mechanics.

questions.question: Which dark fantasy tabletop RPG set in the Old World was highly popular in Europe during the 1990s?
questions.explanation_correct: Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay offered a gritty, low-fantasy counterpoint to D&D, featuring a deadly career system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Das Schwarze Auge is Germany's most popular system, Midgard is an early German RPG, and Call of Cthulhu is set in Lovecraft's mythos.

questions.question: What is the name of the mountain fortress and Witcher school of the Wolf, where Geralt was trained?
questions.explanation_correct: Kaer Morhen (Keep of the Elder Sea) is the remote, ruined fortress where Wolf school Witchers were created.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Kaer Trolde is a keep in Skellige, Vizima is the Temerian capital, and Oxenfurt is a university town in Redania.

questions.question: Which 2007 RPG developed by BioWare launched an epic sci-fi trilogy starring Commander Shepard?
questions.explanation_correct: Mass Effect blended third-person shooter combat with dialogue choices that carried over into sequels.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Dragon Age is dark fantasy, KOTOR is a Star Wars license, and Jade Empire is martial arts fantasy.

questions.question: Which 2D browser-based Polish MMORPG launched in 2006 became a major hit in Eastern Europe?
questions.explanation_correct: Margonem is a classic Polish 2D browser RPG that attracted a large player base in Poland.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Broken Ranks is a modern isometric 3D MMORPG, while Tibia is German and Metin2 is Korean.

questions.question: In which tabletop RPG system do players assume the roles of vampires struggling with their Beast in a hidden society?
questions.explanation_correct: Vampire: The Masquerade, published by White Wolf in 1991, established the World of Darkness setting.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Call of Cthulhu deals with Lovecraftian horrors, DCC is retro dungeon crawl, and Kult is gnostic horror.

questions.question: Which Belgian studio created the Divinity series and developed the critically acclaimed Baldur's Gate 3 (2023)?
questions.explanation_correct: Larian Studios, led by Swen Vincke, rose to fame with Divinity: Original Sin before developing Baldur's Gate 3.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Obsidian, BioWare, and InXile are prominent North American RPG studios.

questions.question: What does AC stand for in D&D-derived RPG systems?
questions.explanation_correct: Armor Class (AC) is the value an attacker must roll equal to or higher than to land a hit.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Attack, Action, and Avoidance are incorrect terms in D&D mechanics.

questions.question: Which Gothic faction features a temple dedicated to the fire god Innos on Khorinis?
questions.explanation_correct: The Fire Novices and Magicians live in the Monastery of Innos, a key sanctuary in Gothic II.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Paladins serve the King and Innos but live in the city port, Mercenaries are neutral, and the Old Camp belongs to the first game.

questions.question: Which country is the origin of Tibia, one of the oldest and most popular online MMORPGs?
questions.explanation_correct: Tibia was created in 1997 by four German students who went on to found CipSoft.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Although popular in Poland and Brazil, the game was developed in Germany.

questions.question: Which attribute is NOT one of the six primary stats in Dungeons & Dragons?
questions.explanation_correct: The six primary stats are Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma. Speed is a derived value.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Strength, Wisdom, and Constitution are primary attributes in D&D.

questions.question: In which year is the story of CD Projekt Red's cyberpunk RPG set?
questions.explanation_correct: Cyberpunk 2077 is set in the year 2077 in the metropolis of Night City, California.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other years (2020, 2045, 2013) are historical settings in the Cyberpunk tabletop RPG universe.

questions.question: Which BioWare RPG franchise set in the world of Thedas features conflicts with the Darkspawn?
questions.explanation_correct: Dragon Age debuted in 2009 with Dragon Age: Origins, focusing on a dark fantasy world under threat by a Blight.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Mass Effect is sci-fi, Jade Empire is martial arts fantasy, and Neverwinter Nights uses the D&D license.

questions.question: Which RPG based on H.P. Lovecraft's writings features investigations where players risk losing their Sanity?
questions.explanation_correct: Call of Cthulhu, released by Chaosium in 1981, introduced the classic Sanity (SAN) stat mechanic.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Delta Green is a modern military spin-off, Deadlands is weird west, and Miseria is unrelated.

questions.question: Which development studio created Arcanum: Of Steamworks and Magick Obscura in 2001, blending magic with steampunk?
questions.explanation_correct: Troika Games was formed by key Fallout creators after they left Interplay.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Black Isle and Interplay were publishers/studios, and Lionhead created Fable.

questions.question: Which Slavic god is represented as a sun rune in The Witcher games to enhance fire chance?
questions.explanation_correct: The Dazhbog runestone increases the chance of inflicting the Burning status effect on enemies.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Perun represents lightning, Veles represents the underworld, and Svarog represents fire/blacksmithing.

questions.question: Which 2001 isometric fantasy MMORPG by Webzen was famous for its shiny wings and upgrade systems?
questions.explanation_correct: Mu Online featured fast hack-and-slash combat and a highly popular gear reinforcement system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Metin2 is a 3D MMORPG, Lineage II is Unreal Engine 3D, and Silkroad focused on Silk Road trade runs.

questions.question: In RPG terminology, what does 'min-maxing' mean?
options: Maximizing character strengths while minimizing unnecessary stats or weaknesses
Playing the game on both the lowest and highest difficulty settings
Equally distributing all stats for a balanced character
questions.answer: Maximizing character strengths while minimizing unnecessary stats or weaknesses
questions.explanation_correct: Min-maxing is the practice of optimizing a character's stats to make them as powerful as possible in a specific role.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options describe difficulty settings, balanced builds, or pacifist runs.

questions.question: Which classic Polish tabletop RPG published in 1993 on the pages of MiMag magazine is set in a fantasy world of time crystals?
questions.explanation_correct: Kryształy Czasu (Crystals of Time) by Artur Szyndler was Poland's first local fantasy RPG system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Oko Yrrhedesa was by Sapkowski, Wiedźmin RPG came later, and Monastyr was a 2000s dark fantasy.

questions.question: Which 2011 action RPG developed by Bethesda Game Studios became famous for the shout 'Fus Ro Dah'?
questions.explanation_correct: Skyrim introduced Dragon Shouts (Thu'um) and became one of the most successful RPGs of all time.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Fallout 3 is post-apocalyptic, Dragon's Dogma is by Capcom, and Fable III is by Lionhead.

questions.question: What is the capital of the Nilfgaardian Empire in the Witcher universe?
questions.explanation_correct: The city of Nilfgaard (often called the City of the Golden Sun) is located far south on the river Alba.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cintra is a conquered northern kingdom, Vizima is the capital of Temeria, and Toussaint is a vassal duchy.

questions.question: Which 2004 action MMORPG by Ymir Entertainment became highly popular in Eastern Europe for its Metin stone battles?
questions.explanation_correct: Metin2 gained a massive following due to its free-to-play model, hack-and-slash combat, and guild wars.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Tibia and Mu Online are older isometric games, while Aion is a 3D MMORPG featuring flight.

questions.question: Which Dungeons & Dragons edition introduced the Open Game License (OGL), spawning the d20 system boom?
questions.explanation_correct: Released in 2000, D&D 3rd Edition allowed third-party publishers to print compatible books using the d20 ruleset.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Second Edition had no open license, Fourth Edition restricted licenses, and Fifth Edition continued the OGL tradition.

questions.question: Which developer created the 2003 RPG Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, featuring the protagonist Darth Revan?
questions.explanation_correct: BioWare developed KotOR, crafting one of the most famous narrative twists in gaming history.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Obsidian developed the 2004 sequel, LucasArts was the publisher, and Black Isle did not work on the game.

questions.question: What is the name of the dimension-traveling elf race in the Witcher series that makes up the Wild Hunt?
questions.explanation_correct: The Aen Elle (Elves of the Alders) inhabit the world of Tir ná Lia and differ from the Aen Seidhe who live in Geralt's world.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Aen Seidhe are the elves of the Continent, Drow are from D&D, and High Elves are from Warcraft/Elder Scrolls.

questions.question: Which 2001 browser-based MMORPG by Jagex allowed players to train skills without being locked into character classes?
questions.explanation_correct: RuneScape gained millions of players due to its accessible browser play and deep skill systems.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Tibia was a 2D download client, EverQuest was a 3D client, and AdventureQuest was a single-player Flash game.

questions.question: What does THAC0 stand for in Advanced Dungeons & Dragons (2nd Edition) mechanics?
questions.explanation_correct: THAC0 was the roll required to hit a target with an Armor Class of 0, replaced by the d20 system in 3rd Edition.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are completely fictional interpretations of the acronym.

questions.question: Which Polish historical RPG set in the 17th century was co-created by writer Jacek Komuda?
questions.explanation_correct: Dzikie Pola (Wild Fields) captures the atmosphere of Polish nobility, sabers, and Cossack uprisings.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Weto! is a card game in the same setting, Monastyr is dark fantasy, and Sarmacja is a virtual community.

questions.question: Which 2010 action RPG by Obsidian Entertainment stars a courier seeking revenge in post-apocalyptic Nevada?
questions.explanation_correct: New Vegas is highly praised for bringing classic Fallout factions and dark humor into the 3D engine.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Fallout 3 was made by Bethesda, Wasteland 2 is by InXile, and The Outer Worlds is a sci-fi RPG.

questions.question: Which deity in the Gothic universe represents darkness, destruction, and chaos?
questions.explanation_correct: Beliar is the god of death and darkness, serving as the primary antagonistic force in the series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Innos is the god of light, Adanos is the god of balance, and Xardas is a mortal necromancer.

questions.question: Which 1992 RPG by Looking Glass Studios introduced first-person 3D dungeon crawling with physics and texture-mapped graphics?
questions.explanation_correct: Ultima Underworld featured a fully 3D engine that allowed looking up and down, jumping, and swimming.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Eye of the Beholder and Dungeon Master were grid-based step dungeon crawlers, and Might and Magic IV was turn-based.

questions.question: Which 1989 tabletop RPG system by FASA blends cyberpunk themes with fantasy races and magic?
questions.explanation_correct: Shadowrun is famous for merging corporate deckers and cybernetics with elves, dragons, and magic.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cyberpunk 2020 has no magic, Rifts is a multi-genre system, and Earthdawn is high fantasy.

questions.question: To which island in Gothic II does the Nameless Hero travel after the destruction of the magic barrier?
questions.explanation_correct: Khorinis is the island containing the port city, the monastery, and the mining valley.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Irdorath is Beliar's temple island, Jharkendar is the addon valley, and Al Shedim is a ruins site in Gothic 3.

questions.question: Which 2003 MMORPG by CCP Games is set in the New Eden galaxy and is famous for its player-driven economy and massive space battles?
questions.explanation_correct: EVE Online is known for its complex economy, corporate politics, and massive player-fought battles.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Star Trek Online, Elite, and Dual Universe do not have the same level of corporation-driven history.

questions.question: What does XP stand for in RPGs?
questions.explanation_correct: Experience Points (XP) are accumulated to level up characters and acquire new skills.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect interpretations of the acronym.

questions.question: What is the primary die-rolling mechanic in the Polish RPG Dzikie Pola?
questions.explanation_correct: Dzikie Pola uses a percentile d100 test for skill resolutions, rolled using two ten-sided dice.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The game does not use a d20, d6 pool, or d12 for its core resolution.

questions.question: Which action RPG released in 2000 stars agent JC Denton uncovering global conspiracies?
questions.explanation_correct: Deus Ex combined FPS action with deep roleplaying choices, hacking, and stealth mechanics.
questions.explanation_incorrect: System Shock is a survival sci-fi game, and Vampire: Bloodlines is a vampire RPG released in 2004.

questions.question: Which university town in the Witcher universe is famous for its Academy of Sciences and scholars?
questions.explanation_correct: Oxenfurt hosts the famous Oxenfurt University, where Dandelion and Shani studied.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Novigrad is a free port city, Vizima is the Temerian capital, and Tretogor is the Redanian capital.

questions.question: Which 1998 Black Isle game is the sequel to Fallout, featuring the Chosen One searching for the G.E.C.K.?
questions.explanation_correct: Fallout 2 expanded the franchise's humor, player choice, and post-apocalyptic scope.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Fallout Tactics is a spin-off tactical game, Fallout 3 is a 2008 3D game, and Wasteland 2 is a 2014 sequel to Wasteland.

questions.question: Which Swedish gnostic horror RPG system describes reality as an illusion trapping humanity?
questions.explanation_correct: Kult (1991) is a dark gnostic horror RPG focusing on waking up from the illusion of reality.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Symbaroum is dark fantasy, Mutant is post-apocalyptic, and MÖRK BORG is art-punk fantasy.

questions.question: Who is the leader of the mercenaries in Gothic's New Camp, previously a general for King Rhobar II?
questions.explanation_correct: General Lee was framed by nobles and sent to the colony, where he took command of the New Camp mercenaries.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thorus leads the Old Camp guards, Diego is a Shadow, and Gorn is a mercenary warrior.

questions.question: Which 2012 MMORPG by ArenaNet dropped the traditional 'Holy Trinity' of roles in favor of dynamic events?
questions.explanation_correct: Guild Wars 2 replaced standard tank-healer-DPS setups with self-sufficient hybrid classes.
questions.explanation_incorrect: World of Warcraft, Tera, and Final Fantasy XIV still utilize the traditional tank/healer/DPS roles.

questions.question: In RPG terminology, what does 'cooldown' mean?
options: The time required for an ability to recharge before it can be used again
An status effect that freezes enemies with ice magic
The time needed to recover health outside of combat
A fatigue meter that limits movement speed
questions.answer: The time required for an ability to recharge before it can be used again
questions.explanation_correct: Cooldowns prevent players from spamming their most powerful spells or attacks continuously.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options describe ice magic, health recovery, or fatigue systems.

questions.question: Which Chaosium RPG system is set in the bronze-age mythic world of Glorantha?
questions.explanation_correct: RuneQuest (1978) introduced the d100 BRP system in the detailed world of Glorantha.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Pendragon is about Arthurian knights, and Stormbringer is based on Elric of Melniboné.

questions.question: Which 2004 Troika Games RPG is set in modern Los Angeles and is based on the World of Darkness tabletop system?
questions.explanation_correct: Vampire: Bloodlines on the Source engine is highly praised for its writing, voice acting, and distinct vampire clans.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Redemption was an earlier 2000 RPG, Vampyr was released in 2018, and Blood Omen is part of Legacy of Kain.

questions.question: In which abandoned castle in Temeria does Geralt cure King Foltest's daughter of her striga curse?
questions.explanation_correct: The fight and subsequent cure of the striga Princess Adda take place in the old castle in Old Vizima.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Vizima Castle is the King's active palace, and Kaer Morhen is the Witcher keep.

questions.question: Which studio revolutionized JRPGs by releasing Final Fantasy VII in 1997 for the PlayStation?
questions.explanation_correct: Square (now Square Enix) developed FF7, transitioning the series to 3D models and cinematic FMV cutscenes.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Enix was a rival developer that merged with Square in 2003. Konami and Capcom focus on other genres.

questions.question: In which tabletop RPG system do players pilot giant battle robots (BattleMechs) in the Inner Sphere?
questions.explanation_correct: Classic Battletech/Mechwarrior blends miniature wargaming with role-playing in a setting of feudal space houses.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Robotech is based on the anime, Heavy Gear is a competitor, and Rifts is a Palladium multi-genre RPG.

questions.question: Who is the leader of the Water Mages in Gothic's New Camp?
questions.explanation_correct: Saturas leads the Water Mages, seeking to blow up the magical ore mound to break the barrier.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Cor Kalom is from the Sect Camp, Xardas is a hermit necromancer, and Milten is a Fire Mage.

questions.question: Which 2003 MMORPG by Square Enix was the first online multiplayer entry in the Final Fantasy franchise?
questions.explanation_correct: Final Fantasy XI was a major success on PC and PS2, pioneering cross-platform play.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Final Fantasy XIV launched in 2010, X-2 is single-player, and Phantasy Star Online is by Sega.

questions.question: What is a 'debuff' in RPGs?
options: A negative effect applied to a character that lowers stats or limits movement
The ability to cure poison from an ally
questions.answer: A negative effect applied to a character that lowers stats or limits movement
questions.explanation_correct: Debuffs (like poison, slows, or armor reduction) reduce the combat efficiency of a character.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Upgrades are buffs, curing poison is a cleanse, and mana regen is resource recovery.

questions.question: What is the stat that determines a character's physical health pool in the Call of Cthulhu RPG?
questions.explanation_correct: Hit Points determine how much physical damage an investigator can take before dying or falling unconscious.
questions.explanation_incorrect: SAN is sanity, CON is the attribute used to calculate HP, and POW is mental power/magic.

questions.question: Which 2009 PS3 action RPG by FromSoftware laid the gameplay foundations for the Dark Souls series?
questions.explanation_correct: Demon's Souls established the tough combat, currency loss upon death, and online messages used in Dark Souls.
questions.explanation_incorrect: King's Field was their 90s first-person predecessor, while Bloodborne and Sekiro were released later.

questions.question: Which duchy in the Witcher universe is famous for its knightly tournaments, peaceful landscapes, and vineyards?
questions.explanation_correct: The Duchy of Toussaint is the setting of the Blood and Wine expansion, inspired by southern European romance and tales.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Sodden, Cintra, and Lyria are northern kingdoms heavily ravaged by wars.

questions.question: Which 1985 RPG by Richard Garriott introduced the system of Virtues instead of defeating an evil wizard?
options: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar
questions.answer: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar
questions.explanation_correct: In Ultima IV, players sought to become a spiritual leader (the Avatar) by acting virtuously in the world.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Bard's Tale, Wizardry, and Might and Magic focused on classic dungeon crawling and monster slaying.

questions.question: Which space opera tabletop RPG was created by West End Games in 1987, introducing the D6 System?
questions.explanation_correct: The Star Wars RPG by West End Games heavily shaped the Star Wars expanded universe lore and names.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Traveller was a 1970s hard sci-fi system, Fading Suns is gothic space opera, and Coriolis is a Swedish space RPG.

questions.question: What is the name of the swamp camp faction in the first Gothic game that worships a mysterious Sleeper deity?
questions.explanation_correct: The Brotherhood of the Sleeper is led by Y'Berion and seeks to escape the barrier by worshipping the Sleeper.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Sect Camp is a common fan name, and the others refer to members/ranks.

questions.question: Which 2001 RvR MMORPG by Mythic Entertainment focused on a three-way faction war based on Arthurian, Celtic, and Norse myths?
questions.explanation_correct: Dark Age of Camelot is highly praised for its Realm vs Realm (RvR) PvP system between Albion, Hibernia, and Midgard.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Warhammer Online was released in 2008, and EverQuest II and Rift are PvE-focused games.

questions.question: What does NPC stand for in RPGs?
questions.explanation_correct: An NPC is any character in the game that is not controlled by the player (e.g., vendors or quest givers).
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect interpretations of the acronym.

questions.question: What is the name of the occult books in Call of Cthulhu that investigators read to learn spells at the cost of Sanity?
questions.explanation_correct: Mythos Tomes (like the Necronomicon) grant Cthulhu Mythos skill points but decrease maximum Sanity.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are generic terms not officially used in the game's mechanics.

questions.question: Which 2022 action RPG developed by FromSoftware in collaboration with writer George R.R. Martin became a massive sales success?
questions.explanation_correct: Elden Ring combined soulslike gameplay with a vast open world in the Lands Between, designed with George R.R. Martin's lore.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Sekiro is an action game, while Dark Souls III and Bloodborne are earlier linear entries.

questions.question: Who is the Nilfgaardian Emperor in the Witcher universe, known as the 'White Flame'?
questions.explanation_correct: Emhyr var Emreis is the ruler of Nilfgaard and Ciri's biological father.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Voorhis and Calveit are other Nilfgaardian figures, and Radovid V is the King of Redania.

questions.question: Which studio developed the post-apocalyptic RPG Wasteland 2 under the direction of Brian Fargo?
questions.explanation_correct: InXile successfully crowdfunded Wasteland 2, reviving the classic post-apocalyptic franchise.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Obsidian, Bethesda, and Troika are other RPG developers not involved with Wasteland 2.

questions.question: In which tabletop RPG do players play as cowboys and gunslingers in a weird west full of magic and zombies?
questions.explanation_correct: Deadlands blends classic western tropes with horror, steampunk, and card-based magic mechanics.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Werewolf is World of Darkness, Castle Falkenstein is Victorian steampunk, and RuneQuest is bronze-age fantasy.

questions.question: What is the name of the sleeping demon summoning target in the first Gothic game?
questions.explanation_correct: The Sleeper (Krushak in Orcish) is an arch-demon summoned by Orc shamans that caused the barrier to go out of control.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Sleeper Demon and Gothic Demon are descriptive terms rather than the official name.

questions.question: Which 2003 MMORPG by NCSOFT became famous for its siege wars and racial conflicts in the world of Aden?
questions.explanation_correct: Lineage II was famous for its 3D graphics on Unreal Engine 2 and its PvP-focused castle siege system.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Aion launched in 2008, Guild Wars is coop-focused, and Ragnarok Online is 2D isometric.

questions.question: What does RNG stand for in RPGs?
questions.explanation_correct: RNG refers to the random number generation that determines combat hits, critical chances, and loot drops.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect interpretations of the acronym.

questions.question: What type of dice rolling test is used in Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay for skill resolution?
questions.explanation_correct: WFRP uses a d100 percentile system where players roll under or equal to their stat/skill value.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Success pools are used in Shadowrun, d20 checks are in D&D, and d10 pools are in World of Darkness.

questions.question: Which 1999 game by Looking Glass Studios merged FPS, survival horror, and RPG elements on the spaceship Von Braun?
questions.explanation_correct: System Shock 2, directed by Ken Levine, is a classic sci-fi horror RPG that inspired BioShock.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Deus Ex is a grounded cyberpunk conspiracy game, BioShock is its spiritual successor set in Rapture, and Dead Space is a pure TPP action game.

questions.question: What is the name of the secret society of sorceresses in the Witcher universe, founded after the Thanedd coup?
questions.explanation_correct: The Lodge of Sorceresses was founded by Philippa Eilhart to secretly influence world politics after the fall of the Brotherhood.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Brotherhood, Council, and Chapter were the older, official governing bodies of mages destroyed at Thanedd.

questions.question: Which developer created the Might and Magic RPG series and the Heroes of Might and Magic spin-off strategy series before its 2003 bankruptcy?
questions.explanation_correct: New World Computing, founded by Jon Van Caneghem, developed both long-running fantasy series.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Sir-Tech created Wizardry, Black Isle worked on Fallout/Planescape, and Westwood created Lands of Lore.

questions.question: In which Warhammer 40k tabletop RPG do players act as acolytes serving the Inquisition?
questions.explanation_correct: Dark Heresy (2008) focuses on investigators exposing heresies and cults inside the Imperium of Man.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Rogue Trader is about void merchants, Deathwatch is about Space Marines, and Only War is about the Imperial Guard.

questions.question: What is the name of the necromancer hermit in Gothic who was formerly a Fire Mage?
questions.explanation_correct: Xardas is the key necromancer in the Gothic series who guides the Nameless Hero to his destiny.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Saturas leads the Water Mages, Milten is a young Fire Mage, and Corristo was the Fire Mage leader executed by Gomez.

questions.question: Which 2004 MMORPG by Gravity Corp. featured 2D anime sprites in a 3D environment?
questions.explanation_correct: Ragnarok Online was a massive hit in Asia and Europe, famous for its job progression, cute aesthetics, and War of Emperium PvP.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Maplestory is side-scrolling 2D, Tree of Savior is its later spiritual successor, and Elsword is a 2.5D brawler.

questions.question: What does 'aggro' mean in multiplayer and party-based RPGs?
options: The hostility of a monster focused on a specific target (usually the tank)
The attack speed of a character
The ability to deal area-of-effect damage
questions.answer: The hostility of a monster focused on a specific target (usually the tank)
questions.explanation_correct: Managing aggro is a vital team mechanic in MMOs and RPGs to keep squishy healers and damage dealers safe.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Attack speed, AoE damage, and armor reduction are unrelated combat terms.

questions.question: What is the name of the minimalist Polish RPG ruleset created by Michal Oracz for quick pick-up-and-play sessions?
questions.explanation_correct: Dech is a minimalist Polish ruleset designed for fast, setting-neutral one-shot sessions.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Neuroshima is a full post-apocalyptic setting, while the others are board games or unofficial rulesets.

questions.question: Which action RPG series by Nihon Falcom features fast-paced real-time combat and rock-inspired music, starring Adol Christin?
questions.explanation_correct: The Ys series has been running since 1987, featuring fast action combat and soundtracks by Falcom Sound Team jdk.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Trails is Falcom's turn-based series, Xanadu is a legacy action RPG, and Zwei is a lighthearted action RPG series.

questions.question: What is the capital of the Kingdom of Redania in the Witcher series?
questions.explanation_correct: Tretogor is the fortified capital of Redania, housing the royal palace of King Vizimir.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Novigrad is a free city-state, Oxenfurt is Redania's university town, and Maribor is in Temeria.

questions.question: Which 1981 game by Robert Woodhead and Andrew Greenberg launched a legendary first-person party-based dungeon crawler series that heavily influenced early JRPGs?
options: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
questions.answer: Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord
questions.explanation_correct: Wizardry introduced first-person vector wireframe dungeons and custom party creation, inspiring games like Dragon Quest.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ultima I had an overworld map, Rogue founded the roguelike genre, and Aklabeth was the pre-Ultima game.

questions.question: What is the attribute that determines magic points (MP) and magical defense in Call of Cthulhu?
questions.explanation_correct: Power (POW) is the primary stat for mental willpower, magical reserves, and resisting spells in Call of Cthulhu.
questions.explanation_incorrect: APP is appearance, EDU is education/knowledge, and INT is intelligence.

questions.question: What is the name of the king's elite guard order in Gothic II that wears heavy plate armor decorated with red cloth?
questions.explanation_correct: The Paladins are the elite royal knights sent to Khorinis to secure magic ore for King Rhobar II.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The Templars guard the Sect Camp, Mercenaries serve Lee, and Shadows are Old Camp members.

questions.question: Which 2007 MMORPG allows players to explore Middle-earth and fight the forces of Sauron?
options: The Lord of the Rings Online
questions.answer: The Lord of the Rings Online
questions.explanation_correct: The Lord of the Rings Online features a highly detailed, lore-faithful recreation of Tolkien's Middle-earth.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Age of Conan is set in Hyboria, and D&D Online is set in Xen'drik.

questions.question: What does a 'stat check' mean in RPG gameplay?
options: Comparing a character's attribute value against a difficulty threshold to determine the outcome of an action
Verifying the character sheet for bugs
Resetting the difficulty scaling of the game
A system for comparing gear in PvP
questions.answer: Comparing a character's attribute value against a difficulty threshold to determine the outcome of an action
questions.explanation_correct: Stat checks compare stats (e.g. Strength or Intelligence) against a difficulty level to resolve actions like lockpicking or persuasion.
questions.explanation_incorrect: The other options are incorrect interpretations of the term.

questions.question: What is the name of the mechanic in D&D 5th Edition where the DM can ask you to roll two d20s and take the lower result?
questions.explanation_correct: Disadvantage requires rolling two d20s and taking the worse result, simplifying numerical penalties.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Advantage takes the higher result, modifier penalties are flat numbers, and a critical miss is rolling a 1.

questions.question: Which 2005 Nihon Falcom game was a complete action RPG remake of Ys III: Wanderers from Ys?
questions.explanation_correct: The Oath in Felghana is a 3D isometric action platformer remake of Ys III, highly praised for its combat mechanics.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Ys SEVEN launched in 2009, Ys Origin is a prequel, and Xanadu Next is a different Falcom franchise.

questions.question: Which Koviri mage was a member of the Chapter of Wizards and served as an advisor to King Esterad Thyssen?
questions.explanation_correct: Carduin of Lan Exeter represented Kovir in the Chapter and survived the Thanedd coup.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Istredd is Yennefer's lover in Aedd Gynvael, Dorregaray is a monster advocate, and Dethmold is Kaedwen's royal advisor.

questions.question: Which 1993 dungeon crawler by Westwood Studios featured a step-based grid movement system and was set in the land of Gladstone?
options: Lands of Lore: The Throne of Chaos
questions.answer: Lands of Lore: The Throne of Chaos
questions.explanation_correct: Lands of Lore featured beautiful 2D graphics, accessible gameplay, and voice acting by Patrick Stewart as King Richard.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Eye of the Beholder III was SSI's final trilogy entry, Stonekeep used digitized actors, and Anvil of Dawn was released in 1995.

questions.question: Which tabletop space fantasy RPG was released by Wizards of the Coast in 2000 utilizing the d20 system?
questions.explanation_correct: Wizards of the Coast published the d20 Star Wars system shortly after obtaining the license from West End Games.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Starfinder is Paizo's sci-fi spin-off, Rifts is by Palladium, and Fading Suns is by Holistic Design.

questions.question: Who is the mercenary commander in Gothic's New Camp who was formerly Rhobar II's general?
questions.explanation_correct: General Lee was framed by Myrtana's nobles and exiled to Khorinis's colony, where he led the mercenaries.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Thorus leads Old Camp guards, Diego is a Shadow, and Gorn is a mercenary companion.

questions.question: Which 2003 MMORPG by tri-Ace featured real-time combat and allowed players to control territories in a fantasy setting?
options: Star Ocean: Till the End of Time
questions.answer: Star Ocean: Till the End of Time
questions.explanation_correct: Star Ocean 3 (Till the End of Time) featured a major plot twist revealing that the universe is a simulated MMORPG.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Phantasy Star Online 2 and Blue Protocol are other online action RPGs from Japan.

questions.question: What is a 'buff' in RPG gameplay?
options: A positive effect applied to a character that temporarily increases stats
questions.answer: A positive effect applied to a character that temporarily increases stats
questions.explanation_correct: Buffs (like haste, armor shields, or strength increases) boost a character's stats for a duration.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Trap-detecting is detection, inventory weight is encumbrance, and shield moves are shield bash.

questions.question: What is the stat that determines a character's physical health pool in D&D, abbreviated as HP?
questions.explanation_correct: Hit Points (HP) represent a combination of physical health, stamina, and willpower to survive combat.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Constitution is the stat used to calculate HP, Armor Class is defense, and Stamina is not a primary stat.
